title: hieracium sabaudum subsp. rigidum
intro: Hieracium sabaudum subsp. rigidum, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of digestive issues, and support of immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium sabaudum subsp. rigidum include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
